# MailMyPDF

> Upload a PDF, enter U.S. addresses, and we print and mail it as a physical letter — no printer, no envelope, no post office trip.

MailMyPDF is a paid online service for sending PDF documents through the U.S. postal system. Guest checkout, standard black-and-white letters, U.S. domestic mail only. Certified mail and international mail are not offered.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What MailMyPDF does and how it works.
- [Find your order](/orders): Look up an existing order by ID and confirmation token.
